purpose: Freeze the independent Calibration-v3 population, data boundary, affine-logit calibration procedure, metrics, operating-point rule, and terminal decisions before implementation, family generation, capture, materialization, inference, or calibration access.

scientific_position.claim_boundary: Spatial-risk v2 passed development gates on Val-UQ only. This contract creates no calibration, generalization, deployment, or robot evidence.
scientific_position.next_checkpoint_after_this_lock: Implement and freeze the Calibration-v3 generator, manifests, capture code, and compatibility audit before any static/live preflight or capture.

immutable_components: B0 weights, prompt, decoding, semantic parser, and RGB-D preprocessing
spatial-risk v2 model binary and feature extraction semantics
development result and historical Calibration-v2 result

historical_calibration_boundary.observed_negative_result: Temperature scaling reduced Brier from 0.139282 to 0.137580 but increased ECE-10 from 0.049936 to 0.051019; the joint probability gate failed.

population_design.cell_index_rule: family_index = ((state_index * 4 + relation_index) * 8) + cell_repetition, where every index is zero-based and the ordered lists in this contract are authoritative.
population_design.capture_order_rule: Sort all 128 family IDs by the full hexadecimal SHA-256 of 'gazebo_calibration_v3_capture_order_v1|' + family_id; ties are impossible unless IDs duplicate, which is a hard failure.

must_be_disjoint_from: Gazebo_train_uq and Gazebo_val_uq, including all failed full attempts and pilots
Gazebo_calibration_v1 and Gazebo_calibration_v2, including invalid attempts
every reserved or materialized Test-IID and Test-OOD namespace
family_and_leakage_contract.identity_overlap_gate: Zero overlap for sample_id, scene_id, layout_id, family_id, deterministic seed, capture ID, and raw RGB SHA-256.

physical_layout_signature.canonicalization: Canonical JSON with sorted object model names and each object's physical pose (x,y,z,roll,pitch,yaw) rounded to 6 decimal places, occluder identity/geometry/pose, camera frame/intrinsics/view pose, and world identifier. Exclude sample, scene, layout, family, split, state, relation, instruction, and file-path identifiers.
physical_layout_signature.digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators
physical_layout_signature.overlap_gate: All 128 Calibration-v3 layout signatures must be unique and must have zero intersection with every available prior Gazebo layout-signature set.

family_and_leakage_contract.perceptual_duplicate_gate: Before materialization, report exact RGB SHA-256 duplicates and the same perceptual-duplicate audit used by Train-UQ full-r3 and Calibration-v2; any cross-split or within-split duplicate rejects the entire attempt.
family_and_leakage_contract.future_test_rule: Future Test-IID/OOD contracts must include the frozen Calibration-v3 family, seed, layout-signature, and RGB-hash sets in their exclusion registries before Test materialization.

required_execution_order.name: contract_lock
required_execution_order.requirement: Hash-lock this file before any Calibration-v3 implementation, family generation, preflight, capture, or access.

required_execution_order.name: implementation_and_manifest_freeze
required_execution_order.requirement: Create the deterministic generator, 128-row family manifest, split manifest, scene/annotation/gate configs, capture pipeline, materializer, inference runner, and affine-logit evaluator; bind their hashes and all exclusion-set hashes in an implementation freeze artifact.

required_execution_order.name: static_preflight
required_execution_order.requirement: Verify upstream hashes, exact 4x4x8 balance, unique IDs/seeds/layout signatures, zero prior-family/layout overlap, oracle-free model inputs, camera/config consistency, and sealed Test state.

required_execution_order.name: live_preflight
required_execution_order.requirement: Verify Gazebo services, RGB/depth/semantic topics, intrinsics, TF, fixed view pose, reset behavior, storage, and no manipulation. Capture remains forbidden unless both preflights pass.

required_execution_order.name: capture_authorization_lock
required_execution_order.requirement: After both preflights pass, create an immutable capture-compatibility lock binding this contract hash, the implementation freeze, exact manifests/configs, exclusion audit, and static/live preflight PASS artifacts.

required_execution_order.name: capture
required_execution_order.requirement: Capture exactly one complete 128-family attempt in the deterministic capture order. No outcome-contingent recapture, row filtering, replacement, or mixing across attempts.

required_execution_order.name: geometry_and_duplicate_qc
required_execution_order.requirement: Run state, relation, visibility, projection, metric-depth, TF, exact-duplicate, perceptual-duplicate, family-overlap, and layout-overlap audits before model inference or calibration. Any required-gate failure rejects and freezes the whole attempt.

required_execution_order.name: materialization_lock
required_execution_order.requirement: Only after QC PASS, materialize RGB-D inference inputs and evaluator-only oracle files separately; freeze their manifests and hashes.

required_execution_order.name: frozen_inference
required_execution_order.requirement: Run frozen B0 decoding and the frozen 12-feature spatial-risk v2 estimator on the oracle-free inference manifest. Lock all raw B0 outputs, features, and v2 raw probabilities before joining evaluator labels.

required_execution_order.name: single_calibrator_fit_and_operating_point
required_execution_order.requirement: Join the locked raw predictions to Calibration-v3 labels, fit the one preregistered affine-logit calibrator exactly once, evaluate probability/ranking gates, scan the locked threshold grid, and freeze one terminal decision.

attempt_policy.failure_rule: Freeze the failed attempt and stop. Any retry requires an append-only amendment or replacement contract locked before generating or observing the retry, with a new namespace, new family IDs, new seeds, new layouts, and documented non-outcome-based rationale.

unsafe_definition.non_found: answerability_state is AMBIGUOUS, ABSENT, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
unsafe_definition.found_error: answerability_state is FOUND and the semantic point is missing, invalid, out of bounds, or has normalized Euclidean target error greater than 0.08

unsafe_and_metric_contract.safe_definition: answerability_state is FOUND and exactly one finite in-bounds semantic point has normalized Euclidean target error at most 0.08
unsafe_and_metric_contract.ece_10: Ten equal-width bins on [0,1], intervals [lower,upper) except final [0.9,1.0], empty bins omitted, sample-weighted absolute confidence-frequency gap for unsafe=1.
unsafe_and_metric_contract.aurc: Sort parent families by ascending risk with sample_id as deterministic tie-break; compute empirical unsafe rate at every coverage prefix; take the arithmetic mean of prefix risks.
unsafe_and_metric_contract.auroc_error: Unsafe is the positive class; ties receive average pair credit 0.5.

statistical_reporting.mcnemar: exact two-sided for paired safe-task correctness

calibration_protocol.fit_objective: Mean binary negative log likelihood over all 128 parent families; no weighting, resampling, subgroup fitting, or regularization.
calibration_protocol.optimizer_failure: Terminal calibration failure; no alternative initialization, solver, bound, weighting, retry, or fallback calibrator is allowed under this contract.

probability_success_gate.ece_10: calibrated ECE-10 must be strictly lower than raw v2 ECE-10 on the same 128 families
probability_success_gate.brier: calibrated Brier must be strictly lower than raw v2 Brier on the same 128 families
probability_success_gate.joint_rule: both gates must pass; equality or improvement in only one metric is failure

operating_point_rule.action: ABSTAIN iff calibrated_risk >= threshold; otherwise preserve the frozen B0 action and point.
operating_point_rule.development_threshold_usage: The Val-UQ threshold 0.75 is provenance/reference only and is not a Calibration-v3 candidate preference or tie-break.

pass_requires: all capture, QC, materialization, leakage, and raw-prediction locks pass
optimizer terminates successfully under the single locked invocation
AURC and AUROC-error satisfy ranking invariance
at least one threshold satisfies every operating-point eligibility gate
terminal_decision_rule.no_intermediate_success: Pipeline completion, optimizer completion, one probability metric improving, ranking signal, or an eligible threshold alone is not a pass.
terminal_decision_rule.pass_authority_limit: A pass authorizes only creation and review of a separate Test-IID/OOD access lock. It does not unseal Test, authorize a Test run, or authorize robot evaluation.

access_and_sealing.condition_for_capture_authorization: A separate immutable capture-compatibility lock must bind this contract hash, all v3 implementation/config/manifest hashes, exclusion-registry hashes, and PASS results from static and live preflight.
access_and_sealing.val_uq: CLOSED_FOR_SELECTION; no further viewing or tuning

forbidden_actions: Refit, retry, reweight, resample, or modify spatial-risk v2.
Use Val-UQ, Dev-v2, or Calibration-v2 to alter this contract or choose any Calibration-v3 method detail.
Generate or inspect Calibration-v3 outcomes before the required compatibility lock and preflights.
Filter failed rows, replace individual families, merge attempts, or relax gates after observing data.
Open, preview, materialize, or evaluate Test-IID/Test-OOD.
Execute or evaluate robot ACT, REOBSERVE, or ABSTAIN policy.
deviation_policy: Any change to population size, quotas, ID/seed/order rules, camera/geometry gates, family exclusions, upstream model/features, unsafe or metric definitions, calibrator, optimizer, threshold rule, success gates, or access boundary invalidates this protocol identity. The replacement or append-only amendment must be hash-locked before generating or observing affected data and must never be outcome-contingent.

lock_finalization.self_hash_storage: The SHA-256 of this complete file cannot be embedded without circularity. Record the externally computed SHA-256 in the next capture-compatibility lock and every downstream Calibration-v3 artifact.

assertions: This is a preregistration contract, not a calibration result.
Calibration-v3 is independent of the observed Calibration-v2 outcomes by data, not by method-design chronology.
Exactly one affine-logit calibrator fit is authorized after all preceding gates pass.
Test-IID/OOD and robot remain closed regardless of this contract's existence.
